item.title: Mise
item.author: emecas
item.description:
Mise
https://mise.jdx.dev/
Your dev env,already prepped. One tool to manage languages, env vars, and tasks per project, reproducibly.

Everything in its place, before you code.
In a professional kitchen, mise en place is the ritual of prep: knives sharpened, onions diced, stock warm, station clean. The work before the work.
mise does the same for your dev env. It activates the right language versions, loads the right env vars, and wires up the right tasks for the commands you run.

item.title: Processing
item.author: emecas
item.description:
Processing
https://processing.org/
Processing is a flexible software sketchbook and a language for learning how to code. Since 2001, Processing has promoted software literacy within the visual arts and visual literacy within technology. There are tens of thousands of students, artists, designers, researchers, and hobbyists who use Processing for learning and prototyping.

Processing Foundation: https://processingfoundation.org/

Flavors:

- Processing {tradicional] : https://processing.org/
- p5.js : https://p5js.org/
- Processing Android : https://android.processing.org/
- Processing Python : https://py.processing.org/
